全成就以后写一些感想： 职业： 战士（阿塞尔多）： 1.剑武器开局几乎是首选毫无疑问的，其他两个武器严重缺乏竞争力，建议加强。 2.狂怒技能是否可以修改为“在你击杀了若干怪物后增加%的伤害”等其他效果来增加这个天赋选择的竞争力。 3.炮烙之踏效果不是很理想，在高难度的时候我是不会想选这技能，他没有什么竞争力。 法师（哈弗格林）： 1.狱火之典的2个进化都很难让人产生兴趣，建议修改技能重做。 缺损（？）： 1.作为隐藏角色，我不在乎他是否随机使用了其他职业的技能模组，但是我强烈建议给他一个独特的大招（绝技），而不是和别人使用一样的大招（绝技）。这样不会让他成为一个更有趣的角色！！！！！！！！！！！！！ 圣物： +1攻击的石头可以修改一下属性吗？？？？ 谢谢……每次我进入游戏发现杀掉100个怪物会给一块+1攻击的石头的的时候我内心是崩溃的，甚至想直接重开游戏了。 系统： 1.希望有淡化法术和降低法术细节的选项，在中后期随着怪物的增加和角色收集、升级武器之后效果的提升，对老机器来说很卡。 2.关于商店，我希望可以升级圣殿来获取更多有趣的东西！增益BUFF，随机任务奖励物品，更加华丽的帐篷和更多的物品可供选择！！！（只是我单纯的想法）另外，商人很可爱。 感谢你们的游戏，感谢美术，期待下一个新的升级和更多有趣的内容加入！祝身体健康！

《北欧之烬：诸神黄昏幸存者》 ——幸存者杯"S3"赛季的黄金一代 幸存者游戏，或者叫"幸存者Like" 大概至今最后创立了一种全新游戏模式的热潮 我个人感觉大概截止到目前， 大概经历了4个赛季 "S1"赛季是<吸血鬼幸存者>的崛起 此前虽然有些类似风格的游戏，但并没形成系统玩法 直到这个看起来痴痴呆呆，用免费素材拼接成的萌新作品 大热后 玩家才后知后觉的发现，此子恐怖如斯，有必定成功的道理 用付款，在线时间，好评堆积出一个新的游戏巅峰 (上一个还是杀戮尖塔，并诞生了"尖塔Like") "S1"大抵是始祖(虽然现在还活着)和往前追溯的版本 玩家这个时候只能玩初代，和更早以前有些类似的游戏 "S2"赛季是高仿的类似出现 游戏的大热带来了一波热潮，但短短的时间谁也不敢确定 通往成功的因素是什么？ 是玩法解压？是割草无双？是加点设计的正反馈？是碎片化游戏时间？还是超武升级？ 感觉每一条都像，每一条又都不是 所以大部分要在几个月内赶工赶出来的新英雄 开发者像是研究一个模型一样，拆了但是没敢大修 万一改掉的正是大火的精华怎么办？ 所有"S2"赛季的"幸存者Like"就像是换皮的本体 不同的画面，不同的角色，不同的画面，相同的内核 高仿才是唯一主旋律 "S3"赛季是截止目前最高潮的一个赛季 大部分开发者在观望和摸索中 已经大概理解了"幸存者Like"的机制和原理 但因为此时市面上已经充斥了"S2"赛季的大部分英雄 所以新英雄 基本都是老牌，资深，专业的独立游戏开发者入场研发的 内核和游戏扎实度上都更上一层楼 "S3"主打一个融合 要脱颖而出，要击败对手，关键是创新和融合 与卡牌融合，与清版游戏融合，与爬塔融合，与僵尸融合，与机甲融合 本作《北欧之烬：诸神黄昏幸存者》 就是这个时期的黄金作品 现在大概是"S4"赛季的末期 新赛季主打一个双重融合+IP联名互动+创新到变异 老老实实的游戏品质已经无法打动玩家了， 毕竟同质化游戏太多了 只能走 1，超级创新，让人感觉很新奇(不代表很好玩)， 眼前一亮冲动付款，反正这类游戏不停更新，退款的玩家挺少的 2，深耕某一领域，专门吸引某一个领域的玩家， 可谓双重融合，双倍的快乐， 你也可以理解本体元素为主，"幸存者"元素去打辅助 "S5"赛季不清楚嘛时候推出，也不清楚新赛季会是怎样，期待ing 说回游戏本身 《北欧之烬：诸神黄昏幸存者》诞生的 北欧爆肝之花 花语是:"隐忍和克制" ——类似土豆兄弟，底层数据架构做得特别好 1，是玩法上逼迫你不停的收集物资， 这个物资大部分是金币，当局消费而不是局外成长， 收集了当场提升，快乐不间断， 而且金币不同于buff，用的时候是有一个思考的过程，代入感更强 2，用商店时间和BOSS时间，把一个稍长的游戏时间 切成3-4段，避免了无意义的发呆时间 或长时间高强度操作的疲劳感 3，技能都不算强，但是可以堆，重点是堆积了也不算变态 怪也不算强，而且一招一式方便背板 不存在秒或者完全打不过 无论顺利与否，手残与否 都可以battle几个回合，给一种我稍微再来两下就通关了错觉 属于运气，操作，爆肝(场外成长)可以互换互补 而玩这个的玩家不能三不沾，总的有一项靠得住 感觉目前在江湖上的地位 做不得武林盟主，创立门派还有点距离 但在任何门派都可以当一个长老 不管按照什么个人爱好排"幸存者Like"的榜单 都能扎实的功力进入前列-"做八望五" 不多嗦了 一上午没玩幸存者游戏，我要死了.JPG

+ Combat & game play is good --- Meta progression is grindy hell, with the expectation you play each character on all levels to unlock all the leaf. - Not all characters are created equal, some characters are still buggy or gameplay is highly undesirable - DLC is its own separate game, with separate grind and mechanic that remains separate from main game. This game is fun for a bit, but lacks the drawing power to get you to keep playing. Dev should really take a few pages from VS.

6/7/26 - Devs "fixed a bug" recently which put many many people very much in the negative on the main progression mechanic. This is a single player PVE game. Them saying "thanks for understanding" is laughable. The absolute least should have been making everyone who would have been negative for "getting unintended leaves" at 0 not leaving them negative. Changing my review to negative to match. Apparently this has happened in the past and the devs shoulder shrugged that too based on discussion comments. I already recommended this and even bought a copy for a friend. Very disappointing Noxfall. 5/25/26 - There are a lot of unlocks. The skill tree gets increasingly (much) slower to unlock skills as your progress. There are a lot of characters but it seems a number are locked behind achievements or one kind or another. While I like this, and would still recommend it, I suspect this is going to turn in to a Soulstone Survivors situation of essentially infinite grind. Nice art, good sound design and great music. A well rounded and solid roguelite survivor game. Not the best, not the worst, but worth the money and decent. There doesn't seem to be a "gimmick" or a specific unique thing which stands out about this, at least not that I've seen in the first 90 minutes.

I'm going to leave a negative review currently. The game is fun and I've been playing it for about a week but every time there is a small update the leaves on the Yggdrasil tree go into the negative, sometimes by an excessive amount. The dev says the tree was providing free points but that hasn't felt like my experience since I've only been unlocking nodes each time I have points available and have never seen any upgrades not cost points. Anyways, because of the compounding cost of leaves and this consistent issue that happens almost every single update, you need to spend an excessive amount of time grinding just to recover the points you lost each update before you can start progressing the tree again which is really demoralizing. No matter the context of the bug, it is the developers responsiblity to provide a functional and enjoyable experience for the people who have paid for their game and being consistently punished because of bugs in the game is just simply not fun. That aside if you plan to purchase this game, it is a fun experience but be aware that this bug happens almost every update no matter how small and will likely cause you some frustration with the devs lack of accountability and dismissive responses to the consistent issue.

I would recommend this game if you can get it under 5 bucks. It looks pretty, but the overall feel of the gameplay is quite awkward. I applaud the effort of making everything visually really great, because I am a sucker for eyecandy, but the VS-like genre lives and dies by how great it feels to first grow through a bit of skill and patience and then to eventually get more and more OP. Well, I am afraid that that part is just a lot more meh than the visuals and the overall mobility just plain feels..weird. Sluggish, mildly nonreactive, drifty, you get the idea. Its still an okay entry into the genre, it just is nowhere close to deserving 10 bucks at full price and the fact that they are putting out DLC at a price point of half that is...neh, If you want to know what better entries and in 3D would look like I would recommend "Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel" for example.

Incredibly moreish, good pace of new characters / features. Got the lightning mode just as I was feeling runs were taking too long. Unlockables require playing other characters. Despite the incentive to invest in a single character (mastery) I found each character I unlocked was more powerful than the last, which really invites playing the new ones for at least a bit. Took a while for my first non-Midgard Expert (Amaranth), but after that I ran Expert on each level, one after another. I appreciate having Expert unlocked for all of them after finishing Hard in Midgard instead of having to unlock it for each individually. Nice Vampire Survivors references in Blud, and his Unholy Vespers-like weapon is my favourite (and the close range bats serve as similar to the close-range Garlic of that game). Would appreciate an option to lower the time you have to hold down the buttons to accept them, though. Makes rushing through the constellation in the early setup slightly more annoying than it has to be.
